title: Goobomon Sr
description: A mod-pack focused around cobblemon and create, with several content addons for each as well as several QoL mods.
body:
This modpack is centered mainly around Cobblemon and Create. There are several companion mods added to expand on the content from both of these mods, along with a few world generation/structure mods, and some QoL mods.

For cobblemon, the pack has Mega Showdown, Journey Mounts, Smartphone, Size Variation, and Cobbreeding. You can now Mega evolve your pokemon, ride even more pokemon, access your PC on the go, and breed your pokemon. Pokemon are now also spawned as a random size, allowing you to catch tiny/huge versions of your favorite mons.

For create, the pack has Crafts & Additions, Deco, Bells & Whistles, Copycats+, and Contraption Terminals.

For world generation, the pack has Tectonic and Oh The Biomes We've Gone. This adds many more biomes to explore, along with much more interesting terrain generation. It also adds several new structures you can explore with mods like Towns and Towers, and the YUNG suite of overhaul mods. The nether has also gotten some attention, with the overhaul mod Incendium adding new biomes and structures to explore, new mobs to fight, and new items to gather.

This pack is a work in progress. Quests are planned, and mods will be added/removed as needed.
